title: Handy Dandy
description:
The two curious cave adventurers Handy and Dandy have accidentally caused an inter-dimensional

tear which is now not only separating them, but the entire cave that they have to progress

through to make things right and come together again in this 2D puzzle solving coop game.



Work as one to bring your characters back

together, unite their world and stand strong

against all the treacheries and puzzles of the

cave. Handy and Dandy will be thankfull, and

if they had arms they would surely give you

a hug. But they don't, so they can't.



- Test your friendship (and patience)

- Over 40 levels, 2 dimensions and 1 barrier

- Over 1h of fun
description_short: The two adventurers Handy and Dandy have caused a dimensional tear which is now separating them and the entire cave where they have to solve platforming puzzles to reunite again in this 2D co-op game.
